headline: Western Oregon have the title in their own hands
dek: Western Oregon's only conference defeat came at Seattle Pacific, and they have since beaten the leaders at home. Seattle Pacific have only Northwest Nazarene left in conference play; Western Oregon visit Simon Fraser and Western Washington, and winning both would lift them beyond anything Seattle Pacific can still reach.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Saint Martin's 32 goals are more than Simon Fraser, Western Washington or Northwest Nazarene have scored, yet they sit bottom of the table: most of their goals have come against sides outside the conference, not in the matches the table counts.

wire.line: Saint Martin's have won seven matches, none of them in conference play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches whose dates have passed carry no result, and every one of them is a Simon Fraser home match from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Seattle Pacific have won thirteen matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Archie Dhima has 16 goals from 52 shots for Western Oregon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Elijah Brockl has kept seven shutouts for Northwest Nazarene.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Of the shots on target Austin Valdez has faced for Western Oregon, 76 were saved and 21 went in.

last_match.line: Northwest Nazarene had held Western Oregon scoreless when the two met earlier in the month.

next_match.line: Western Oregon and Simon Fraser drew without a goal on the opening day of conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
